nextStoryContext: Biome and the debt-marker, fixed-sleep, and tmpdir-root gates now scan webui. Bun.Glob scanSync requires brace alternatives at one path-component depth, so the script globs use {test,webui} or {src,scripts,webui} and the path filters exclude webui/dist and other generated client directories. All seven US-003 behavioral oracles and the full quality spine pass.
